tr.ti: Prepare source packages and do any necessary patching or fixes.

body.p: The default implementation applies the patches listed in the PATCHES variable, followed by any user patches:
body.note: You must call eapply_user or default if you define src_prepare!
body.p: Because of the -- separator, every item of PATCHES is treated as a path name, so options for patch cannot be passed through this variable. Call eapply explicitly if you need them, or rebase the patch to the usual patch level:
In EAPI 7, the -- separator is not used, and items of PATCHES that begin with a hyphen are passed to patch as options instead.
The following subsections cover different topics which often occur when writing src_prepare functions.
